status: Post hoc manuscript development after inspecting the initial 50 models. Not preregistered.
aim: Check whether residual shifts in person means after covariate-based row exclusions alter interpretation of the negative-affect slope.
additional_fits: Ten within-between adjusted coping models: daily mean and last eligible report, five source imputations each. Recenter source-standardized negative affect within each eligible participant's analysis rows, include the participant mean as a separate covariate, retain the coping interaction and original covariate set.
inference_check: Re-pool existing coping models with participant-count-based complete-data degrees of freedom as an explicitly approximate sensitivity, without refitting.
reporting: Report every additional model's sample, convergence and Hessian; do not pool failed models or omit them based on significance. Keep source-data processing and imputation attribution. Add full coefficient and interaction tables, numerical verification and primary literature.
public_scope: Original analysis code, aggregate results, manuscript, figures and data download/hash manifest only. Exclude participant data, model objects, CVs, application ratings, interview coaching, personal substance-use history and credentials.
authorship: Nicholai Chasseau is named as author of this independent secondary-data working paper. AI implementation and manuscript assistance are disclosed in an author note. Do not claim independent data collection, peer review or completed author validation.
